**Valmont depot handover**

**Established:** 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, 410 daily departures, 1.8% cancellations, winter peak 530. Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. Ops lead: Halvard Onstad. Night supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic. Parts store: 1100 line items; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim.

**Rules:** Brake check every 6000 km. Fuel card needs second approval above €200. Part above €500 needs two quotations. Route change: 7 days' notice. Incident report: 24 hours. Roster: single named publisher.

**Failed/fixed:** Feb 2025 brake line failure grounded 9 vehicles 4 days; cause unestablished. Sept 2024 fuel card cloned, €4200 lost. May 2026 duplicate roster left 2 shifts uncovered.

**Planned:** Second charging bay Q3. Electrification study approved, unfunded. Parts contract renegotiated Nov 2025. Training revised April 2026.

**Open:** Night shift understaffed. Old ticketing terminal on 3 routes. Winter peak capacity unmodelled.
